G001.target_statement: Always have something playing in the background, including during exam and peak-stress periods when listening drops to a 3 or 2.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: T011 在考试/高压条件下仍称 still need something playing，T079 再次以 always need 与 does not do well with silence 表述同一状态；主体、条件、强度（always/need）与目标一致。
supported_parts: 背景持续有声音的状态
考试与高压期的例外条件

G002.target_statement: Use background music to distract from real-world stress so that daily life feels less overwhelming.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: T013 是受访者对“为什么需要以这个频率听音乐”的回答，明确把分散现实压力作为目的；kind of 的弱强度已在 statement 与 context 保留。
supported_parts: 以背景音乐分散现实压力这一目的

G003.target_statement: Play music from his own pre-curated playlists, picking the playlist that fits what he needs at that moment and playing it on shuffle with the whole playlist repeated.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: T027 逐步陈述选择歌单、shuffle 与整张循环的实际做法，T033 给出 70% 占比；目标只把该做法表述为意图，origin 记为 inferred（由习惯推断），但整句内容由原文直接支持。
supported_parts: shuffle 与整张循环的方式
assumptions: 习惯描述可视为其希望维持的使用方式

G004.target_statement: Find a public playlist that matches the emotion he is currently feeling by searching that emotion or related keywords.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: T033 明确以 I need some songs to find exactly what I'm feeling 表达该情境下的需求，并说明搜索情绪/关键词找公开歌单的方式；条件与占比一并保留。
supported_parts: 以搜索情绪/关键词找公开歌单的方式

G005.target_statement: Find songs that match a concept or vision in his mind by searching with popular keywords, going through playlists and songs, and listening until inspiration strikes.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: T033 明确 I want to find songs to match the vision I have in my mind，并给出关键词搜索与试听到 inspiration strikes 的方式；情境（舞者/购物）与占比保留。
supported_parts: 以心中画面/概念为目标找歌
关键词搜索与逐首试听的方式

G006.target_statement: Discover new songs by starting from a song heard elsewhere, listening to it fully, then using Spotify's similar-song playback to judge whether better songs can be found.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: T055 描述从别处听到的歌入手、完整试听、借相似歌曲判断是否有更好选择；T057 确认听歌单时也会想听新歌，故目标中的发现与比较环节均有原文依据。
supported_parts: 完整试听并用相似歌曲扩展

G007.target_statement: Have music stop automatically after a chosen interval (end of the song, or about 25-30 minutes) so he can fall asleep while listening.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: T065 明确喜欢 sleep timer 及多种停止选项，T067 说明用于入睡；目标按偏好强度表述，未升级为强制要求。
supported_parts: 按选定时长/曲终自动停止

G008.target_statement: Create playlists that other people can easily view and share.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: T067 说明因为用 Spotify 的人多，创建供他人查看的歌单很容易，T047 把社交面向列为偏好理由；目标限于“可被他人查看/分享的歌单”。
supported_parts: 创建他人可查看的歌单

G009.target_statement: Start a shared listening jam session with other listeners.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: T047 把 starting a jam 列为 Spotify 相对 Apple Music 的能力，T067 称 starter jam options really cool；两处均支持“可用并受偏好”，但未支持使用频次，故未写入。
supported_parts: 可发起 jam 的能力

G010.target_statement: Receive Spotify's Made For You mixes in which roughly 10 to 12 out of 20 songs are ones he likes, compared with about 3 out of 20 from search-based playlists.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: T081 说明喜欢 Made For You 区块，T085 给出 3/20 与 10-12/20 的对比；目标保留对象、比较基线与估计性质，未把比例写成承诺。
supported_parts: Made For You 的偏好对象

G011.target_statement: Have good ambient noise available to listen to when he wants it.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: T105 同时给出偶发使用（sometimes I like to）与环境音质量的正面评价，并以 without that I don't think spotify would be spotify 说明其必要性；目标保留“可用且质量好”的内容。
supported_parts: 偶发但重要（三要素之一）

G012.target_statement: See featured public playlists created by ordinary users, ranked by traction, on the home screen, not only playlists made by curators.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: T093 明确 would be nice 的首页推荐公共歌单，并给出 random people、most traction、not just curators 三项限定；T097 修正动机（非主要社交），提议强度保留。
supported_parts: 首页展示推荐公共歌单
普通用户创建与热度排序的限定

G013.target_statement: Get suggested playlists from other listeners who listen to similar songs, derived from the playlists he saves and listens to.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: T099 以 maybe if there is an algorithm 提出基于已保存/收听歌单匹配相似听众并推荐其歌单；T103 补充效果不确定。建议性质与不确定性均在 statement/context 保留，故整句在建议强度下受支持。
supported_parts: 基于已保存与收听歌单
匹配听相似歌曲的其他听众
